serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: SHUT IT! 
Landlord: It’s all written in the contract! Can’t you read?!
Landlord: You are right, I can’t prove that there is someone living with you only because I was waiting at your doors for one whole night.
…
Landlord: As I said. There is an easy way or a hard way. You can just pay me more every week or…{{wi}} I can just put a 5$ store camera at your door, record it all and go with it to a court!
You: !
T-that would be terrible!
You: There is no way something like this is legal!
Landlord: I don’t care how, but I will find a way to catch you. With that hefty fine in the contract, you'll be paying me thousands of dollars. Hahaha!
He’s not joking…{{wi}} I don’t want to bring any more attention to my bot and if he’s even willing to bring this to court I just have to go along with it…
You: Alright… You won. I will pay that 500$.
Landlord: Glad you finally made the obvious choice, hehe~ Was it that hard? You probably had this squatter there for a few weeks already! I don’t know how I could miss something like that, I guess my senses are declining with age …
Landlord: It’s only 500$ a week. You should be grateful I don’t want any payments for you hiding her there!
Landlord: That will be 1300$ in total every week, don’t forget it or you are out!
